arxiv-2108-12809.title: The rUNSWift SPL Field Segmentation Dataset
arxiv-2108-12809.creator: Wentao Lu
arxiv-2108-12809.description: Abstract In RoboCup SPL, soccer field segmentation has been widely recognised as one of the most critical robot vision problems. Key challenges include dynamic light condition, different calibration status for individual robot, various camera prospective and more. In this paper, we propose a dataset that contains 20 videos recorded with Nao V5/V6 humanroid robots 1 1 1 https://www.softbankrobotics.

arxiv-2212-07913.title: Newtonian cosmology from quantum corrected Newtonian potential
arxiv-2212-07913.creator: Rituparna Mandal, Sunandan Gangopadhyay, Amitabha Lahiri
arxiv-2212-07913.description: Abstract We study the Newtonian cosmology taking into account the leading classical and quantum corrections of order 𝒪 ⁡ ( G 2 ) \mathcal{O}(G^{2}) in the Newtonian potential. We first derive the modified Friedmann equations starting from the non-relativistic conservation of kinetic energy and potential energy for an infinitesimal mass.

arxiv-2301-00917.title: Anomalous circular phonon dichroism in transition metal dichalcogenides
arxiv-2301-00917.creator: Wen-Yu Shan
arxiv-2301-00917.description: Abstract Magnetic field can generally induce circular phonon dichroism based on the formation of Landau levels of electrons. Here we study the magnetization-induced circular phonon dichroism in transition metal dichalcogenides, without forming the Landau levels. We find that, instead of the conventional deformation potential coupling, the pseudogauge-type electron-phonon coupling plays an essential role in the emergence of the phenomenon.

arxiv-2301-08430.title: Heat kernel on Ricci shrinkers (II)
arxiv-2301-08430.creator: Yu Li, and, Bing Wang
arxiv-2301-08430.description: Abstract This paper is the sequel to our study of heat kernels on Ricci shrinkers in [ 28 ] . In this paper, we improve many estimates in [ 28 ] and extend the recent progress of Bamler [ 2 ] .

arxiv-2310-04854.title: Repelling Random Walks
arxiv-2310-04854.creator: Isaac Reid, Eli Berger, Krzysztof Choromanski, Adrian Weller
arxiv-2310-04854.description: Abstract We present a novel quasi-Monte Carlo mechanism to improve graph-based sampling, coined repelling random walks . By inducing correlations between the trajectories of an interacting ensemble such that their marginal transition probabilities are unmodified, we are able to explore the graph more efficiently, improving the concentration of statistical estimators whilst leaving them unbiased.

arxiv-2410-01335.title: Layer Swapping for Zero-Shot Cross-Lingual Transfer in Large Language Models
arxiv-2410-01335.creator: Lucas Bandarkar Benjamin Muller Pritish Yuvraj Rui Hou Nayan Singhal Hongjiang Lv Bing Liu Meta GenAI
arxiv-2410-01335.description: Abstract Model merging, such as model souping, is the practice of combining different models with the same architecture together without further training. In this work, we present a model merging methodology that addresses the difficulty of fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for target tasks in non-English languages, where task-specific data is often unavailable.

arxiv-2412-20743.title: Magnetic excitations and interactions in the Weyl ferrimagnet NdAlSi
arxiv-2412-20743.creator: Chris J. Lygouras, Hung-Yu Yang, Xiaohan Yao, Jonathan Gaudet, Yiqing Hao, Huibo Cao, Jose A. Rodriguez-Rivera, Andrey Podlesnyak, Stefan Blügel, Predrag Nikolić, Fazel Tafti, Collin L. Broholm
arxiv-2412-20743.description: Abstract Weyl fermions can arise from time-reversal symmetry-breaking magnetism, but their impact on magnetic order is a source of ongoing research. Using high-precision neutron diffraction and spectroscopy, we present a comprehensive exploration of the magnetic structure and excitation spectrum of Weyl semimetal and helical magnet NdAlSi.

arxiv-2502-16779.title: Unposed Sparse Views Room Layout Reconstruction in the Age of Pretrain Model
arxiv-2502-16779.creator: Yaxuan Huang, Xili Dai, Jianan Wang, Xianbiao Qi, Yixing Yuan, Xiangyu Yue
arxiv-2502-16779.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yaxuan Huang, Xili Dai, Jianan Wang, Xianbiao Qi, Yixing Yuan, Xiangyu Yue. Room layout estimation from multiple-perspective images is poorly investigated due to the complexities that emerge from multi-view geometry, which requires muti-step solutions such as camera intrinsic and extrinsic estimation, image matching, and triangulation. However, in 3D reconstruction, the advancement of recent 3D foundation models such as DUSt3R has shifted the paradigm from the traditional multi-step structure-from-motion process to an end-to-end single-step approach.

arxiv-2504-07421.title: AgentAda : Skill-Adaptive Data Analytics for Tailored Insight Discovery
arxiv-2504-07421.creator: Amirhossein Abaskohi, Amrutha Varshini Ramesh, Shailesh Nanisetty, Chirag Goel, David Vazquez, Christopher Pal, Spandana Gella, Giuseppe Carenini, Issam H. Laradji
arxiv-2504-07421.description: Abstract We introduce AgentAda , the first LLM-powered analytics agent that can learn and use new analytics skills to extract more specialized insights. Unlike existing methods that require users to manually decide which data analytics method to apply, AgentAda automatically identifies the skill needed from a library of analytical skills to perform the analysis.

arxiv-2509-13814.title: Findings of the Third Automatic Minuting (AutoMin) Challenge
arxiv-2509-13814.creator: Kartik Shinde, Laurent Besacier, Ondřej Bojar, Thibaut Thonet, Tirthankar Ghosal
arxiv-2509-13814.description: Abstract This paper presents the third edition of AutoMin, a shared task on automatic meeting summarization into minutes. In 2025, AutoMin featured the main task of minuting—the creation of structured meeting minutes—as well as a new task: question answering (QA) based on meeting transcripts.

pmc-10683365.title: A Pyridine Dearomatization Approach for the Gram Scale Synthesis of (±)-Sparteine
pmc-10683365.creator: Pik Hoi Lam, Jeff K. Kerkovius, Sarah E. Reisman
pmc-10683365.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Both enantiomers of sparteine have suffered from pricing and supply chain variability, which has inspired efforts toward efficient chemical synthesis. Here, we build upon our reported synthesis of the matrine-type lupin alkaloids in order to synthesize (±)-sparteine. Specifically, selective quenching of the cyclization between glutaryl chloride and pyridine with methanol provides a functionalized quinolizidine core that was elaborated to (±)-sparteine in six additional steps on gram scale.

pmc-11636166.title: Autotransplantation of immature second premolar combined with alveolar ridge splitting: A long‐term (6‐year) follow‐up case report
pmc-11636166.creator: Cheng Feng, YaBin Pan, Lingling Chen, Jianzhe Wang, Zhenyu Shi, Ye Wu
pmc-11636166.description: This case report describes a successful autotransplantation procedure for an impacted mandibular left second premolar with incomplete root formation. Despite caries and root resorption, the patient's mandibular left second primary molar was retained. Furthermore, the severe impaction of the mandibular left second premolar ruled out orthodontic realignment.

pmc-11680299.title: Effects of Vitamin and Mineral Supplementation During Gestation in Beef Heifers on Immunoglobulin Concentrations in Colostrum and Immune Responses in Naturally and Artificially Reared Calves
pmc-11680299.creator: Jennifer L Hurlbert, Friederike Baumgaertner, Kerri A Bochantin-Winders, Isabella M Jurgens, Kevin K Sedivec, Carl R Dahlen, Burim Ametaj
pmc-11680299.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryThe nutritional management of pregnant females can have lasting impacts on offspring growth, health, and well-being during postnatal life. Providing supplemental vitamins and minerals during pregnancy may influence offspring development and immune function. In two experiments, we investigated the impacts of supplementing vitamins and minerals to pregnant beef heifers on immunological components of maternal colostrum and resultant calf immunoglobulins in serum after consuming maternal colostrum or a colostrum replacement product.

pmc-12805125.title: Situation of dementia measured by Revised Hasegawa’s Dementia Scale and its associated factors in Thaibinh, Vietnam

pmc-12805125.description: As Vietnam’s population has been aging, dementia is becoming more prevalent. A cross-sectional study was conducted among 762 older adults living in two communes of Thaibinh Province, Vietnam.

pmc-13679482.creator: Ran Barkai, Ella Assaf, Bar Efrati, Tal Simon, Liad Mudrik, Yoav Ram
pmc-13679482.description: Humans routinely keep souvenirs objects retained for the memories they evoke, yet the evolutionary and cognitive consequences of mnemonic collecting remain unclear.
